name: first-query
sql: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS paid_orders, SUM(total_cents) AS gross_cents FROM paid_orders GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY tenant_id

name: null-counts
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(customer_id) AS known_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customers FROM orders

name: empty-aggregate
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(total_cents) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'missing'

name: wrong-join
sql: SELECT SUM(o.total_cents) AS gross_cents FROM paid_orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id = i.order_id

name: fixed-join
sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price_cents) AS line_cents FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT SUM(o.total_cents) AS gross_cents, SUM(i.line_cents) AS line_cents FROM paid_orders o JOIN line_totals i ON o.order_id = i.order_id

name: net-revenue
sql: WITH refunds AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(refund_cents) AS refund_cents FROM returns GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.tenant_id, SUM(o.total_cents) AS gross_cents, SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)) AS refund_cents, SUM(o.total_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0)) AS net_cents FROM paid_orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY o.tenant_id ORDER BY o.tenant_id

name: customers-without-orders
sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id) ORDER BY c.customer_id

name: wrong-not-in
sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

name: window
sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(total_cents) OVER (PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cents FROM paid_orders WHERE tenant_id = 'north' ORDER BY order_id

name: decimal
sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(total_cents) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) / 100 AS gross_dollars FROM paid_orders

name: schema
sql: SELECT table_name, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'orders' ORDER BY ordinal_position
